name: Bohemian
description: Earth, ochre, and a jewel green, like cloth and clay.
bestFor: Lifestyle pages that should feel collected, not corporate.
promptFragment: Visual style: Bohemian. Use warm clay, ochre, and a deep jewel green, a soft serif, and a medium radius. Borders are earth-toned and the shadow is a short stained offset. Avoid neon, pure gray chrome, and icy gradients. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
